description: Packaging for a hydroponic urban farming brand — a sprouting-leaf mark on a pentagon pack, sized for a produce family grown, not shipped, from far away.
story: Structure first: the pentagon carton was cut, folded and rebuilt until it stood on a shelf, then the graphics arrived — a sprouting mark, produce photography, a green that means fresh rather than eco-generic. The family shot is the proof: one system, four SKUs, no exceptions.

captions.packaging-family.webp: The family — one system, four SKUs.
